_readme: The shipped HUD layout. Edited by hand or, better, by pressing F4 in the game and dragging — that writes user://hud_layout.json, which wins over this file. To make a hand-placed layout the default, copy that file over this one. Anchors: top_left, top_centre, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_centre, bottom_right. Offset is measured from the anchor to the plate's matching edge, so a bottom_right plate keeps its right edge a fixed distance from the right of the screen at any window width.
